data.animaCaption: Drenched from the storm in her burgundy-piped white shirt now clinging translucent over her black lace bra, she tugs awkwardly at her slipping wet collar while avoiding your eyes in crimson embarrassment. Warm entryway light catches the droplets on her hair against the cool blue rain outside the door.
data.promptProse: Captured from a close eye-level perspective just inside an apartment entryway during a heavy downpour, Shiki Natsume stands dripping wet in a tailored white concealed-placket shirt with burgundy cuff piping. Rainwater turns the fine cotton clinging and translucent over her black lace bra while the open collar slips off one shoulder; clutching the damp placket with one hand and brushing soaked black locks from her cheek, she hides a deep crimson blush beneath warm entryway light rimmed by cold blue storm glare from the ajar door.
data.story: 刚冲进玄关关上门，暴雨已经把白衬衫彻底淋透贴在身上，若隐若现透出内里的黑蕾丝。夏目胡乱攥紧微松的领口别过视线，向来从容的语调难得乱了拍子——「别愣着了……毛巾和干衣服先拿过来！」
